*Dashboard developed by Kiran using the tidycensus, sf and tmap packages, data from US Census*

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidycensus) 
library(tidyverse) 
library(sf) 
library(tmap) 
library(tmaptools)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
census_api_key("d696f22b515caa8ef3ea357f14aae75cdf1f745d")

census_data <- load_variables(year = 2020, 
                              dataset = "acs5", 
                              cache = TRUE) # download all variables
View(census_data)

```

```{r, include=FALSE}

ma_data <- get_acs(state = "ma",
                   year = 2020,
                   geography = "county",
                   variables = c("S2701_C01_001E",   # total n of population
                                 "S2701_C02_001E"),  # total n of insured
                   geometry = TRUE, 
                   survey = "acs5",
                   output = "wide")

class(ma_data)

```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
ma_df = ma_data %>% 
  rename(total_pop = S2701_C01_001E,
         total_insured = S2701_C02_001E) %>% 
  mutate(prop_insured = (total_insured/total_pop)*100,
         county = str_extract(NAME, "(\\w+)")) # capture first word of "NAME" column
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ma_map <- tm_shape(ma_df) +
  tm_polygons(col = "prop_insured",
              style = "quantile",
              n = 5,
              palette = "Blues",
              border.col= "black",
              title = "Percent Insured (%)") + 
  tm_legend(legend.position = c(0.35, 0.2)) +
  tm_layout(title = "Percent of population insured in MA in 2020",
            title.size = 1.3,
            legend.title.size = 1.1,
            frame = FALSE) +
  tm_compass(type = "arrow",
             position = c(0.25, 0.1),
             size = 1.15) + 
  tm_scale_bar(position = c(0.3, 0.1),
               size = 0.6) + 
  tm_credits("Author: Kiran Kui \nSource: US Census Data 2020",
             position = c(0.01, 0.1),
             size = 0.7) +
  tm_text(text="county", 
          size = 0.5)

ma_map 
```
